chromium.method: 10s after 2s warmup per paired legacy/skill encounter, immortal player, durable 100000HP enemies to hold entity counts, virtual Xbox primary edge every 700ms aimed away from enemies. Injection-to-observed-skill-start latency measured separately from HUD request-to-start metric. No native hardware latency claim. CPU metrics are rolling p95; ability metric includes combat. Effects count is concurrent statuses and projectiles, not cumulative events.

simulation.method: 100 fresh 40-tick windows, 31 actors, 0/5/10/20/30 simultaneous buff casts. Node Vite SSR, simulation only. Incremental mean includes status work, not a pure function microbenchmark; warmup/JIT/order can dominate tiny deltas.
